# EntitySpeed

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** EntitySpeed

## What it does

Make entities go faster

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/EntitySpeed.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
